# openwebui_prompt (Resource)

Manages a reusable prompt command in Open WebUI. The `command` is the slash-command users type to invoke the prompt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_prompt" "example" {
  command = "summarize"
  name    = "Summarize Text"
  content = "Summarize the following in 3 concise bullet points:\n\n{{text}}"

  read_groups  = ["Support"]
  write_groups = ["Support"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Slash-command identifier, e.g. `summarize`. The leading `/` is normalised automatically.
- `content` (String) Prompt template text. Use `{{variable}}` for user-fillable placeholders.
- `name` (String) Display name of the prompt.

### Optional

- `data_json` (String) Arbitrary JSON metadata object for the prompt. Use `jsonencode({})` to set an empty object.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the prompt is active and available to users. Defaults to `true`.
- `meta_json` (String) Arbitrary JSON metadata object for the prompt. Use `jsonencode({})` to set an empty object.
- `read_groups` (List of String) Names of groups granted read access to the prompt, spelled exactly as stored in Open WebUI (state holds the stored group name, so an ID or a different letter case shows up as a difference). Open WebUI stores every write group as a read group too, so this list always includes the `write_groups` entries. When `read_groups` is not set, its planned value keeps the current read groups and is extended with any `write_groups` entry missing from it. When it is set, it must include every write group: to remove a group from `read_groups`, remove it from `write_groups` too (or set `write_groups = []`). Set both lists to `[]` for no group grants.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags for categorising the prompt.
- `write_groups` (List of String) Names of groups granted write access to the prompt, spelled exactly as stored in Open WebUI. Open WebUI stores these groups as read groups too: when `read_groups` is set it must list every group here, and when it is not set it is extended with them automatically. Leaving `write_groups` unset keeps the current write groups; set it to `[]` to revoke write access.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Set by Open WebUI.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID for the prompt.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-updated date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Set by Open WebUI.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
